title: Auto Comprehensive Coverage
text: Comprehensive auto coverage pays for collision and non-collision damage up to $10,000 per incident, provided the incident date falls within the active policy period.

title: Auto Exclusions
text: Damage sustained while the vehicle is used for racing, ride-share commercial driving, or with an expired registration is excluded from coverage.

title: Auto Liability Coverage
text: Liability coverage pays for injury or property damage caused to third parties in an at-fault accident, up to $50,000, separate from comprehensive coverage.

title: Auto Comprehensive Deductible
text: A $500 deductible applies to each comprehensive claim and is subtracted from the payout before reimbursement.

title: Rental Reimbursement
text: While a covered vehicle is under repair, rental car costs are reimbursed up to $30 per day for a maximum of 15 days.

title: Auto Total Loss Threshold
text: A vehicle is declared a total loss if the estimated repair cost exceeds 75% of its current market value.

title: Windshield Repair
text: Glass damage is covered with no deductible when repaired rather than fully replaced.

title: Windshield Replacement
text: Full windshield replacement is covered but the standard $500 comprehensive deductible applies, unlike chip repair which carries no deductible.

title: Uninsured Motorist Coverage
text: Damage caused by an at-fault driver who carries no insurance is covered up to $25,000.

title: Underinsured Motorist Coverage
text: When an at-fault driver carries insufficient insurance, this policy covers the shortfall up to $25,000 after the other driver's limits are exhausted.

title: Roadside Assistance
text: Towing and lockout assistance are covered up to $100 per incident, limited to three uses per policy year.

title: Auto Collision Deductible
text: Collision claims carry a $750 deductible, higher than the $500 deductible applied to comprehensive claims.

title: Personal Property in Vehicle
text: Personal belongings stolen from inside a covered vehicle are covered up to $1,000, and only when the vehicle shows evidence of forced entry.

title: Vehicle Theft Coverage
text: Theft of the entire vehicle is covered at actual cash value at the time of loss, less the comprehensive deductible.

title: Hail and Storm Damage
text: Hail, falling objects, and storm damage to a vehicle are covered under comprehensive, not collision.

title: Animal Collision
text: Striking an animal is treated as a comprehensive claim rather than a collision claim, applying the lower comprehensive deductible.

title: Unlicensed Driver Exclusion
text: Damage occurring while the vehicle is operated by a driver without a valid license is excluded from all coverage.

title: Permissive Use
text: A friend or family member driving the insured vehicle with the policyholder's permission is covered under the same terms as the policyholder.

title: Modified Vehicle Parts
text: Aftermarket modifications and custom parts are covered only up to $1,500 unless separately declared and scheduled on the policy.

title: Vandalism to Vehicle
text: Intentional damage to a vehicle by a third party, including keying and slashed tires, is covered under comprehensive with the standard deductible.

title: Auto Gap Coverage
text: If a financed vehicle is totaled, the difference between the loan balance and the vehicle's actual cash value is covered only if gap coverage was purchased separately.

title: Commercial Use Exclusion
text: Vehicles used for commercial delivery, freight, or paid passenger transport are excluded unless a commercial endorsement is active on the policy.

title: Auto Diminished Value
text: Loss of resale value following a repaired accident is not reimbursed under this policy.

title: Mechanical Breakdown Exclusion
text: Engine failure, transmission failure, and other mechanical breakdowns from normal wear are excluded; only sudden accidental damage is covered.

title: Auto Medical Payments
text: Medical expenses for the driver and passengers of the insured vehicle are covered up to $5,000 per person regardless of fault.

title: Home Structural Coverage
text: Standard home policies cover damage from fire, theft, windstorm, and burst pipes to the primary dwelling structure.

title: Home Flood Exclusion
text: Flood damage, including basement flooding from heavy rain or rising groundwater, is not covered under a standard home policy and requires a separate flood rider.

title: Burst Pipe Coverage Detail
text: Sudden and accidental pipe bursts are covered, but damage from gradual leaks, corrosion, or long-term wear is excluded.

title: Sewer Backup Exclusion
text: Water entering the home through a backed-up sewer or drain line is excluded unless a sewer backup endorsement is active, and is distinct from both flood and burst pipe claims.

title: Home Theft Sublimit
text: Theft of personal property from the home is covered up to a combined total of $15,000 per claim.

title: Jewelry Sublimit
text: Jewelry and watches are covered only up to $2,000 in total unless individually scheduled and insured separately.

title: Electronics Sublimit
text: Computers, televisions, and other electronics are covered up to $5,000 in total per claim, separate from the general theft sublimit.

title: Firearms Sublimit
text: Firearms are covered up to $2,500 for theft, and require serial number documentation at the time of claim.

title: Cash and Currency Sublimit
text: Cash, coins, and bank notes are covered up to $200 per claim regardless of the amount lost.

title: Earthquake Exclusion
text: Damage caused by earthquake or other earth movement is not covered under a standard home policy.

title: Landslide and Sinkhole Exclusion
text: Ground subsidence, landslide, and sinkhole collapse are excluded and are treated separately from earthquake damage.

title: Home Liability Coverage
text: Injury to a visitor occurring on the insured property is covered up to $100,000 under home liability coverage.

title: Dog Bite Liability
text: Injuries caused by a household dog are covered under liability up to $50,000, half the standard liability limit, and are excluded entirely for breeds listed as restricted.

title: Mold Damage Limitation
text: Mold remediation is covered up to $5,000, and only when the mold results directly from a covered water damage event.

title: Vacant Home Exclusion
text: A home left vacant for more than 60 consecutive days loses coverage for theft and vandalism claims.

title: Additional Living Expenses
text: If the home is uninhabitable due to a covered loss, temporary housing costs are covered up to $200 per day for a maximum of 30 days.

title: Detached Structures
text: Detached garages, sheds, and fences are covered up to 10% of the dwelling coverage limit.

title: Tree Removal
text: Removal of a fallen tree is covered up to $1,000, and only when the tree has damaged a covered structure.

title: Roof Age Limitation
text: Roofs older than 20 years are settled at actual cash value rather than replacement cost, reducing the payout by accumulated depreciation.

title: Wind and Hail Deductible
text: Wind and hail claims carry a separate deductible of 2% of the dwelling coverage amount, rather than the flat standard deductible.

title: Home Standard Deductible
text: A flat $1,000 deductible applies to all home claims except wind and hail, which use a percentage-based deductible instead.

title: Home Business Exclusion
text: Property and liability losses arising from a business operated out of the home are excluded without a home business endorsement.

title: Rental and Tenant Damage
text: Damage caused by a tenant in a rented portion of the home is excluded under a standard homeowner policy and requires landlord coverage.

title: Frozen Pipe Prevention Requirement
text: Water damage from frozen pipes is excluded if the home was unheated and unoccupied and the water supply was not shut off.

title: Swimming Pool Liability
text: Injuries occurring in or around a residential swimming pool are covered only if the pool is enclosed by a fence at least four feet in height.

title: Fire Damage Coverage
text: Fire and smoke damage to the dwelling and its contents is covered at replacement cost, subject to the standard deductible.

title: Arson Exclusion
text: Losses arising from fire intentionally set by the policyholder or at their direction are excluded and are referred for fraud investigation.

title: Power Surge Damage
text: Appliance and electronics damage from a power surge is covered, but surges originating from an on-property wiring fault are excluded.

title: Off-Premises Personal Property
text: Personal property such as bicycles, sports equipment, and luggage is covered while away from the home up to $1,000 combined, under the same theft and accidental damage terms as property inside the home. Mechanical wear, including brake or gear failure from normal use, is not covered.

title: Health Claim Validity
text: Health claims are only valid under policy numbers beginning with the prefix H-. Claims submitted against non-health policy numbers will be rejected.

title: Health Pre-existing Conditions
text: Treatment for conditions diagnosed prior to the policy start date is covered only after a 12-month waiting period has elapsed.

title: Health Annual Deductible
text: A $1,000 annual deductible must be met each policy year before health coverage begins reimbursing claims.

title: Emergency Room Coverage
text: Emergency room visits are covered at 80% after the deductible; urgent care visits are covered at 90%.

title: Ambulance Coverage
text: Ground ambulance transport is covered at 80% after the deductible; air ambulance requires prior authorization except in life-threatening emergencies.

title: Prescription Drug Coverage
text: Generic prescription drugs are covered at 90%, while brand-name equivalents are covered at only 60%.

title: Specialty Drug Coverage
text: Specialty and biologic medications are covered at 50% and require prior authorization before the first fill.

title: Health Out-of-Network Penalty
text: Care received from an out-of-network provider is reimbursed at only 50% of the standard in-network rate.

title: Emergency Out-of-Network Exception
text: Emergency care at an out-of-network facility is reimbursed at in-network rates, overriding the standard out-of-network penalty.

title: Mental Health Parity
text: Mental health and behavioral health services are covered at the same reimbursement rate as physical health services.

title: Substance Use Treatment
text: Inpatient substance use treatment is covered for up to 30 days per policy year following prior authorization.

title: Maternity Waiting Period
text: Maternity coverage requires at least 10 months of continuous enrollment prior to the expected delivery date.

title: Newborn Coverage
text: A newborn is automatically covered for the first 30 days after birth, after which they must be formally added to the policy.

title: Preventive Care Coverage
text: Annual physicals, immunizations, and standard screenings are covered at 100% with no deductible applied.

title: Elective Cosmetic Exclusion
text: Cosmetic procedures performed for appearance rather than medical necessity are excluded, including after a covered injury.

title: Reconstructive Surgery
text: Reconstructive surgery required to restore function after a covered injury or illness is covered, unlike purely cosmetic procedures.

title: Physical Therapy Limit
text: Outpatient physical therapy is covered for up to 20 visits per policy year, after which continued treatment requires medical review.

title: Chiropractic Care Limit
text: Chiropractic visits are covered for up to 12 visits per policy year, a lower limit than outpatient physical therapy.

title: Dental Exclusion
text: Routine dental care is excluded from medical coverage; only jaw injuries resulting from a covered accident are eligible.

title: Vision Exclusion
text: Routine eye exams, glasses, and contact lenses are excluded from medical coverage and require a separate vision plan.

title: Telemedicine Coverage
text: Virtual consultations with in-network providers are covered at 100% with no deductible applied.

title: Durable Medical Equipment
text: Wheelchairs, oxygen equipment, and similar durable medical equipment are covered at 80% with prior authorization.

title: Health Out-of-Pocket Maximum
text: Once $6,000 in out-of-pocket costs is reached in a policy year, all further in-network covered services are reimbursed at 100%.

title: Experimental Treatment Exclusion
text: Treatments not approved by recognized medical authorities, including experimental therapies and clinical trials, are excluded.

title: Inpatient Hospitalization Coverage
text: Hospital admission for inpatient treatment, including for cardiac events, surgical recovery, or extended observation, is covered at 80% after the deductible, separate from emergency room and urgent care visits.

title: Claim Filing Deadline
text: All claims must be filed within 60 days of the incident date. Late claims may be denied regardless of coverage eligibility.

title: Fraud Investigation Clause
text: Claims containing inconsistent dates, amounts, or descriptions across submissions may be flagged for manual fraud review before a decision is issued.

title: Police Report Requirement
text: Any claim involving theft, vandalism, or a third-party collision requires a police report filed within 72 hours of the incident.

title: Policy Cancellation Notice
text: The insurer must provide at least 30 days written notice before cancelling an active policy for any reason.

title: Grace Period for Premium Payment
text: Policyholders are given a 10-day grace period after a missed premium payment before the policy lapses.

title: Policy Reinstatement
text: A lapsed policy may be reinstated within 30 days of lapse, but losses occurring during the lapsed interval are never covered.

title: Subrogation Rights
text: After paying a claim, the insurer may pursue reimbursement directly from an at-fault third party on the policyholder's behalf.

title: Duplicate Claim Prohibition
text: The same loss event cannot be claimed under more than one policy held by the same policyholder.

title: Appeal Process
text: A denied claim may be appealed within 30 days of the denial notice, provided the appeal includes new supporting evidence.

title: Second Appeal Limitation
text: Only one appeal is permitted per claim; a second denial is final unless new material evidence emerges within the original 30-day window.

title: Claim Payment Timeline
text: Approved claims are paid within 15 business days of approval, or within 30 days where third-party assessment is required.

title: Material Misrepresentation
text: Providing false information on a policy application voids coverage retroactively and forfeits all claims made under that policy.

title: Coverage Territory
text: Coverage applies only to losses occurring within the country of issue; international losses require a travel endorsement.

title: Policy Renewal Terms
text: Policies renew automatically each year unless cancelled in writing at least 15 days before the renewal date.

title: Premium Adjustment After Claim
text: Premiums may be adjusted at the next renewal following an approved claim, but cannot be changed mid-term.

title: Beneficiary Claim Rights
text: In the event of the policyholder's death, a named beneficiary may file and receive payment on any outstanding claim.

title: Salvage Rights
text: Once a total loss claim is paid in full, ownership of the damaged property transfers to the insurer.

title: Partial Payment and Advances
text: An advance payment of up to 25% of the estimated claim value may be issued while a claim is still under assessment.

title: Claim Withdrawal
text: A policyholder may withdraw a claim before a decision is issued without affecting future premiums or claim history.

title: Records Retention
text: The insurer retains all claim records, decisions, and supporting evidence for seven years from the date of the claim decision.

title: Third-Party Repair Authorization
text: Repairs begun before insurer authorization may be reimbursed only up to the insurer's own assessed repair estimate.

title: Claim Documentation Expense Reimbursement
text: Reasonable costs incurred to obtain documentation required to support a claim, such as a police report copy or an official incident report, are reimbursed up to $100 per claim.

title: Rideshare Coverage Endorsement
text: Drivers using their vehicle for rideshare or delivery platforms are covered only if a rideshare endorsement is active; the coverage gap during passenger pickup is otherwise excluded.

title: Electric Vehicle Battery Coverage
text: Damage to an electric vehicle's traction battery from a covered incident is reimbursed at actual cash value, but degradation from normal charging cycles is excluded.

title: Key Replacement Coverage
text: Replacement of lost or stolen vehicle keys and key fobs is covered up to $500 per policy year, with no deductible.

title: Towing Distance Limit
text: Covered towing is limited to the nearest qualified repair facility; mileage beyond that is billed to the policyholder.

title: Child Safety Seat Replacement
text: Child safety seats installed in a vehicle involved in a covered collision are replaced at full cost regardless of visible damage.

title: Flood Damage to Vehicle
text: Flood and water damage to a vehicle is covered under comprehensive coverage, unlike home flood damage which requires a separate rider.

title: Repossession Exclusion
text: Loss of a vehicle through lawful repossession by a lienholder is not a covered loss under any coverage type.

title: Trailer and Towed Property
text: A trailer towed by the insured vehicle is covered for physical damage up to $2,500 only if declared on the policy.

title: Custom Paint and Wrap
text: Custom paint jobs and vehicle wraps are covered up to $1,000 unless separately scheduled with documented value.

title: Roadside Fuel Delivery
text: Emergency fuel delivery is covered under roadside assistance, but the cost of the fuel itself is the policyholder's responsibility.

title: Loss of Personal Electronics in Vehicle
text: Portable electronics permanently installed in the vehicle are covered, but loose personal devices such as phones and laptops fall under home contents coverage, not auto.

title: Pothole and Road Hazard Damage
text: Damage to tires and wheels from potholes or road debris is treated as a collision claim and subject to the collision deductible.

title: Home Office Equipment
text: Business equipment used in a home office is covered up to $2,500 for a covered peril, separate from the general electronics sublimit.

title: Spoiled Food from Power Outage
text: Food spoilage resulting from a covered power outage exceeding 24 hours is reimbursed up to $500 with no deductible.

title: Identity Theft Recovery
text: Costs to restore identity after identity theft, including legal fees and lost wages, are covered up to $15,000 when the identity theft recovery endorsement is active.

title: Water Heater Failure
text: Sudden failure of a water heater causing water damage is covered, but replacement of the water heater unit itself due to age or wear is excluded.

title: Solar Panel Coverage
text: Roof-mounted solar panels are covered for physical damage from covered perils up to the dwelling limit, provided they were professionally installed.

title: Fence and Gate Damage
text: Fences, gates, and retaining walls are covered up to 5% of the dwelling coverage limit, separate from the detached structures limit.

title: Debris Removal
text: Removal of debris following a covered loss is included up to 5% of the total claim amount, above the dwelling coverage limit.

title: Ordinance and Law Upgrade
text: Additional costs to rebuild to current building codes after a covered loss are reimbursed up to 10% of the dwelling coverage limit.

title: Guest Property Coverage
text: Property belonging to a guest and damaged in the insured home during a covered loss is reimbursed up to $500, at the policyholder's discretion.

title: Trampoline and Recreational Equipment
text: Liability for injuries involving a trampoline is excluded unless the trampoline has a safety net and was disclosed on the policy.

title: Home Sharing Exclusion
text: Losses occurring while the home is rented to short-term guests through a home-sharing platform are excluded without a home-sharing endorsement.

title: Landscaping and Trees
text: Trees, shrubs, and landscaping are covered up to $500 per item for specific perils such as fire or vandalism, but not for wind or disease.

title: Ambulance Air Transport
text: Emergency air ambulance transport is covered at 70% after the deductible when ground transport is not medically feasible.

title: Chronic Condition Management
text: Ongoing management of chronic conditions such as diabetes, including supplies and monitoring, is covered at 80% after the deductible.

title: Hearing Aid Coverage
text: Hearing aids are covered up to $1,500 per ear every three years, following an audiologist's assessment.

title: Skilled Nursing Facility
text: Care in a skilled nursing facility following a covered hospitalization is covered for up to 60 days per policy year.

title: Home Health Care
text: Medically necessary home health visits ordered by a physician are covered at 80% for up to 40 visits per policy year.

title: Telemedicine Visits
text: Virtual physician consultations are covered at 90% after the deductible, at the same rate as equivalent in-person visits.

title: Assignment of Benefits
text: A policyholder may assign claim benefits directly to a service provider only with written insurer consent.

title: Depreciation and Actual Cash Value
text: Claims settled at actual cash value deduct depreciation based on the item's age and condition at the time of loss.

title: Replacement Cost Settlement
text: Replacement cost coverage reimburses the full cost to replace an item without depreciation, provided the item is actually repaired or replaced.

title: Multiple Policy Coordination
text: When two policies cover the same loss, each pays its proportional share and total reimbursement cannot exceed the actual loss.

title: Catastrophe Deductible
text: Losses arising from a declared catastrophe event are subject to a separate catastrophe deductible higher than the standard deductible.

title: Proof of Loss Deadline
text: A signed proof of loss statement must be submitted within 90 days of the insurer's request or the claim may be denied.

title: Claim Reopening
text: A closed claim may be reopened within one year if new documentation materially affecting the settlement is provided.

title: Rental Car While Traveling
text: A rental vehicle used by the policyholder while traveling is extended the same collision and comprehensive coverage as the insured vehicle, within the coverage territory.

title: Vehicle Storage Coverage
text: A vehicle placed in long-term storage may reduce to comprehensive-only coverage, suspending collision and liability premiums during the storage period.

title: Teen Driver Surcharge Conditions
text: Adding a newly licensed driver under 21 requires disclosure within 30 days; an undisclosed teen driver at fault may result in claim denial.

title: Salvage Title Limitation
text: A vehicle with a salvage or rebuilt title is eligible for liability coverage only, not comprehensive or collision.

title: Sump Pump Failure Coverage
text: Water damage from sump pump or drainage system failure is covered only if a water backup endorsement is active on the policy.

title: Loss Assessment Coverage
text: A homeowner's share of a condo or HOA loss assessment is covered up to $5,000 per assessment for covered perils.

title: Refrigerated Property
text: Loss of refrigerated medication or food due to equipment failure is covered up to $500 with no deductible.

title: Emergency Repairs Reimbursement
text: Reasonable emergency repairs made to prevent further damage after a covered loss are reimbursed even before an adjuster inspection.

title: Collapse Coverage
text: Sudden collapse of a structure from a specified cause such as hidden decay or the weight of ice is covered, but gradual settling is excluded.

title: Scheduled Valuables
text: High-value items such as art, jewelry, and collectibles may be individually scheduled for full coverage above the standard sublimit.

title: Building Materials Theft
text: Theft of building materials during a covered renovation is limited to $1,000 unless the materials are secured and documented.

title: Diagnostic Imaging
text: MRI, CT, and other advanced imaging is covered at 80% after the deductible and may require prior authorization for non-emergency use.

title: Outpatient Surgery
text: Outpatient surgical procedures are covered at 80% after the deductible when performed at an in-network facility.

title: Allergy Testing and Treatment
text: Allergy testing and immunotherapy are covered at 80% after the deductible when medically necessary.

title: Second Opinion Coverage
text: A second medical opinion for a serious diagnosis or recommended surgery is covered at the standard specialist rate.

title: Fertility Treatment Limitation
text: Fertility diagnostics are covered, but assisted reproductive procedures such as IVF are excluded without a fertility rider.

title: General Medical Treatment Coverage
text: Medically necessary treatment for a covered injury or illness, including physician services, diagnostic tests, fractures, wounds, and follow-up care, is covered at 80% after the deductible. This applies to injuries such as broken bones, lacerations, infections, and sprains regardless of where they occurred.

title: Waiting Period for New Policies
text: A 30-day waiting period applies to new policies before non-accident claims become eligible, unless transferring from prior continuous coverage.

title: Cooling-Off Cancellation
text: A policyholder may cancel a new policy within 14 days of purchase for a full premium refund if no claim has been filed.

title: Fraudulent Claim Forfeiture
text: A claim found to contain material misrepresentation or fabricated evidence is denied in full and may void the policy.

title: Partial Loss Settlement
text: A partial loss is settled based on the cost to repair the damaged portion, not the total value of the insured property.

title: Named Insured Definition
text: Coverage extends to the named insured and resident family members; non-resident individuals require separate named endorsement.

title: Loss Mitigation Duty
text: The policyholder is obligated to take reasonable steps to prevent further loss after an incident; failure to mitigate may reduce the settlement.

title: Appraisal Dispute Resolution
text: If the insurer and policyholder disagree on loss value, either may demand an independent appraisal to resolve the dispute.

title: Concurrent Causation
text: When a loss results from both a covered and an excluded cause, coverage applies only to the portion attributable to the covered cause.

title: Policy Transfer on Sale
text: Coverage does not automatically transfer when insured property is sold; the new owner must obtain a separate policy.

title: Electronic Claim Submission
text: Claims submitted electronically are considered filed on the timestamp of submission, subject to the same filing deadlines as paper claims.
